correctness.rationale: Pelaitay-Zuluaga Definition 8.3 specifies precisely T0-T4; for fixed Gödel chain C_m, a right adjoint G or H is a monotone 0/top-preserving map, and its left adjoint is uniquely determined by the first preimage reaching a given level. T4 at x=0 gives G(i)<=F(i), H(i)<=P(i); these inequalities imply all T3 and T4 by the two chain-order cases x<=y and x>y. Under the published congruence-to-tense-filter correspondence, a terminal filter [k,m] is congruent exactly if g(k),h(k)>=k. Adjunction and G<=F,H<=P force all four maps to fix k. Top reflection prevents early hitting of the top, so splitting and gluing at each common fixed cut is bijective. Unique concatenation into simple factors proves B(z)=1/(1-I(z)), I_m=B_m-sum_{j<m} I_j B_{m-j}, congruence-rank coefficients [z^m]I(z)^r and Q_m(t)=[z^m]I(z)/(1-tI(z)). Independently enumerated all monotone admissible pairs through m=5, obtaining B_m=(1,4,29,266,2762), I_m=(1,3,22,203,2118), histograms matching Q4 and Q5. That finite check corroborates but does not replace cut and gluing proofs.
